notes.title: On June 5, Crocell will join the battle
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=W8Wup0ygJ3M;full][/previewyoutube]
"It's incredible. Every time I connect with it, I always feel that it has been with me for a long time. What kind of story does the other "me" have with it..."

┅┅〚Unit introduction〛┅┅
Superbody Name: Frost God and Demon
Prototype: Habakuk
Terrain Adaptation: Naval Battle/Heavy Armor
Synchronizer: Crocell
Middle Duty CV: Sakula Xiaowu
Drive Type: Magnetic Energy
Exclusive Weapon: Frost Burner
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470433/e26dc5f9537fb7d9a64488c2bef9452b436c7c53.jpg[/img]
Derived from the "Abyss Ship Suit" of the old world, Crocell integrated the "quasi-stellar core" of Eta into it, and then independently constructed it for unknown reasons. Since its core has been replaced by the quasi-stellar core, it is still theoretically considered a special Eta machine. The machine has a lot of unknown functions. The Ninth Alliance Research and Development Center believes that reverse research and analysis of what Crossel calls "Abyss Technology" will give the Human Alliance hope of obtaining technology that surpasses Noah Technology for the first time.

>>>Super Body Form<<<
"Is this, a new ship? I can feel... the power of destruction! Haha, what an interesting world~"
[Image]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470433/a1c297619429525fe258bcc8c21e987e0d954440.jpg[/img]
The super body form of Eta, which is based on the core reconstruction of the "Habakuk" machine. This is the first successful attempt after the preliminary analysis of the Abyss Technology attached to the machine. The super-body of the ship suit solves the problem of the original machine's single combat field and lack of firepower output. At the same time, in order to match Crosell's special personality switching, the machine has greatly enhanced the compatibility of the mental link system, allowing Crosell to maintain complete synchronization regardless of his personality state.
In the process of super-body reconstruction of the original machine, the researchers also accidentally partially reproduced the "autonomous construction" phenomenon that occurred when the machine was originally fused with the quasi-stellar core, and obtained extremely valuable technical data. Perhaps in the near future, the research and development of the Eta machine will enter a new milestone stage.

>>> Skill Information <<<
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470433/8c6969c79256ec59359f65df0f5279233449de57.png[/img]

notes.content:

notes.title: Solicitation for key position adjustment proposals
notes.content:
[h2]Dear executives,

Since the launch, we have received a lot of feedback from players and we are working hard to adjust it. We are planning to add a custom button function to address the combat skill button issue.
However, the development of this function will take some time. In order to improve everyone's experience in a short time, we have decided to solicit key adjustment plans.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470433/bebbc3cc102a77b04c069388bd6338046d5a68c4.png[/img]
[b]Current key position[/b]
Character movement: WASD
Inherent skills: 1234
Ultimate skills: ZXCV
Control character switch: Q
Attack character switch: Tab
Normal attack: Space (space bar)
Focus attack: F
Movement acceleration: Shift
Turn perspective: Press and hold the mouse to move
[hr][/hr]
[b]Please copy the following format and give suggestions[/b]
Character movement:
Inherent skills:
Ultimate skills:
Control character switching:
Attack character switching:
Normal attack:
Focus attack:
Movement acceleration:
Rotate perspective:

Character name:
ID number:
[hr][/hr]
[h2]We adhere to the concept of player first and strive to improve everyone's experience. We hope that everyone will actively give suggestions! 
Please include the character name and character ID when giving suggestions. We will give game rewards after the modification. Thank you![/h2]

[b]Feedback address[/b]

notes.title: The official promotional video has been released
notes.content:
In the near future, various forces will compete for interests, and disputes will arise everywhere.

Noah Technology has prioritized the development of a powerful malleable tactical exoskeleton - [E.T.E], and built a huge annular orbital base equipped with super weapons - [Sky Dome] over the equator to monopolize resources.

The sky was obscured by a huge amount of steel, darkness shrouded it, and despair spread.

As a result, the major forces of mankind united and launched a counteroffensive against Noah Technology, which almost wiped out the ecology on the surface. Since then, various forces have jointly developed a new type of combat mecha [E.T.E], established the "Human Alliance", and entered a state of confrontation with Noah Technology.

Somewhere in the world, the Ninth Entente, a combat organization directly under the Human Alliance, is waiting for a visitor......

Your arrival will be a ray of hope for the E.T.E. Maidens, illuminating the long night in the ruins of the apocalypse.

notes.title: The two-dimensional mecha style "E.T.E" is about to be released
notes.content:
E.T.E is a two-dimensional style mecha combat game. The battles in the game are divided into different scenarios of land, sea and air, with rich dimensions of body cultivation. In addition, famous voice actors such as Sakura Tange, Kana Hanazawa, Rie Tanaka, and Mikako Komatsu were invited to perform.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3450390/ETE/
